name: replace_text
description: Replace text in a file (read-modify-write). Two modes: (1) give `old` (exact substring to find) and `new`; (2) give `start_line` and `end_line` (verbatim first/last line of the block to replace) and `new` — the tool locates the block by those two boundary lines and replaces everything between them inclusive, avoiding single-character whitespace mismatches on large blocks. count = number of replacements (default 1; -1 = all). Refuses if the target is not found. Writes to disk, so it requires approval.

old.description: Exact substring to find (must not be empty). Mutually exclusive with start_line/end_line.

start_line.description: Verbatim content of the first line of the block to replace (not a line number). Pair with end_line. Mutually exclusive with old.

end_line.description: Verbatim content of the last line of the block to replace. Must be used with start_line.

new.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete).

count.description: Number of occurrences to replace (default 1; -1 = all).
